name: Run Julia package tests
description: Run the tests in a Julia package

check_bounds.description: Value determining which bounds checking setting to use. Options: yes | no | auto. Default value: yes.

coverage.description: Value determining whether to test with coverage or not. Options: true | false. Default value: true.

depwarn.description: Value passed to the --depwarn flag. Options: yes | no | error. Default value: yes.

force_latest_compatible_version.description: If true, then, for each [compat] entry in the active project, only allow the latest compatible version. If the value is auto and the pull request has been opene

inline.description: Value passed to the --inline flag. Options: yes | no. Default value: yes.

prefix.description: Value inserted in front of the julia command, e.g. for running xvfb-run julia [...]

project.description: Value passed to the --project flag. The default value is the repository root: "@."

annotate.description: Whether or not to attempt to create GitHub annotations to show test failures inline. Only effective on Julia 1.8+.

compiled_modules.description: Whether to run tests with `compiled-modules`. For possible values, refer to https://docs.julialang.org/en/v1/manual/command-line-interface/#command-line-interfa

allow_reresolve.description: Whether to allow re-resolving of package versions in the test environment. Only effective on Julia 1.9+. Options: true | false. Default value: true

test_args.description: Arguments string that is passed on to test.

optimize.description: Set the optimization level for the julia process being run during tests. Options: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3. Default: unset (uses the Julia default).
